title: How Citibank Lost $900,000,000 With One Click

beats.text: At five forty five on a Tuesday evening one click sent nine hundred million dollars out of Citibank.
The money was gone before anyone at the bank looked up.
The bank asked for it back and a judge said no.
It meant to send eight million and it sent one hundred times more.
The judge called it one of the biggest blunders in banking history.
So who clicked and who kept the money and why did the law let them?
This is the nine hundred million dollar click.
The payment leaves at five forty five and nobody notices until morning.
Then the bank asks for its money back and some lenders simply say no.
Almost nine hundred million went out and half a billion never came back.
